小米-7435915383100375148.title: Interior Design Manager/Lead (Advanced Design)
小米-7435915383100375148.description:
We are seeking a talented and visionary Lead Interior Designer to join our Munich-based satellite design studio for a fast-growing Chinese EV company with strong roots in the tech industry.

You will play a leading role in developing bold, forward-thinking exterior designs for next-generation electric vehicles, blending advanced technology, brand character, and emotional appeal. Working in close collaboration with creative teams in Munich and headquarters in China, you will transform early concepts into production-ready designs that set new standards in mobility.

【Key Responsibilities】

1. Creative Leadership in Interior Design
  - Lead interior design projects from initial ideation through to production release.
  - Create compelling sketches, renderings, and 3D models to communicate design intent.
  - Work closely with clay and digital modeling teams to refine proportion, stance, surface quality, and details.
  - Ensure designs push innovation while meeting feasibility, aerodynamics, and safety requirements.

2. Cross-Functional Collaboration
  - Partner with engineering and manufacturing teams to resolve technical constraints without compromising design vision.
  - Align with CMF and UX teams to create cohesive brand expression across vehicle lines.
  - Maintain clear communication with the headquarters design and program management teams in China.

3. Trend & Technology Awareness
  - Monitor global design, lifestyle, and technology trends to inspire fresh ideas.
  - Incorporate EV-specific packaging opportunities into exterior design strategies.

4. Mentoring & Team Development
  - Support and guide junior exterior designers in their creative and professional growth.
  - Contribute to an open, collaborative studio culture that encourages innovation.
小米-7435915383100375148.requirements:
【Qualifications】

1. Essential:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Transportation Design or Industrial Design.
- Minimum 10 years’ professional experience in automotive exterior design (OEM or top-tier design consultancy).
- Strong portfolio demonstrating innovative exterior design concepts through to production.
- Proficiency in design software such as Alias, Blender, VRED, Photoshop, or equivalent.
- Exceptional sketching and storytelling ability to convey design vision.
- Fluent in English, with strong interpersonal and intercultural communication skills.

2. Preferred:
- Experience with electric vehicle programs and understanding of EV packaging advantages.
- Familiarity with aerodynamic development and its impact on exterior design.
- Knowledge of German and/or Mandarin.
- Previous experience working with Chinese OEMs or cross-continental design teams.

3. Key Competencies
- Visionary Creativity: Ability to create distinctive, brand-defining exterior designs.
- Attention to Proportion & Surface Quality: Commitment to delivering world-class design execution.
- Problem-Solving: Resolves technical challenges while protecting design integrity.
- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-moving, global design environment.

*Note: Please attach your CV in English.

小米-7656799151614920998.title: Learning Content Designer
小米-7656799151614920998.description:
1. Create high-quality training presentations, digital learning assets, job aids, facilitator materials, quick-reference guides and supporting communication materials based on approved briefs and source content.
2. Transform existing information and structured learning content into visually compelling and easy-to-understand learning experiences.
3. Create diagrams, infographics, illustrations, product comparison visuals and other visual tools that simplify complex information.
4. Maintain consistently high visual standards and ensure all learning materials align with Xiaomi's brand identity and design principles.
5. Develop reusable templates, design systems and visual assets that improve consistency and production efficiency across European learning programmes.
6. Prepare and adapt content for classroom, virtual, digital and blended learning formats.
7. Support the production and editing of video, photography, animation, motion graphics and other multimedia content as required.
8. Use modern digital and AI-enabled creative tools where appropriate to improve production quality, efficiency and scalability.
9. Support the localisation and adaptation of learning assets across European languages and markets while maintaining the intended design and learning experience.
10. Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the organisation to ensure alignment, effectively integrate requirements and support seamless execution across teams.
11. Maintain well-organised content libraries, templates, source files and version-controlled learning assets.
12. Continuously explore new technologies and creative formats to enhance learner engagement and content quality.
小米-7656799151614920998.requirements:
1. Strong visual and digital design capabilities, supported by a compelling professional portfolio.
2. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and/or InDesign, or equivalent professional creative tools.
3. Proven experience creating professional presentations, visual communication materials or digital content in a commercial, agency, corporate or learning environment.
4. Excellent understanding of typography, layout, information hierarchy, visual storytelling and brand consistency.
5. Experience in video editing, filming, animation, motion graphics or multimedia production is highly desirable.
6. Strong familiarity with modern digital and AI-enabled content creation tools.
7. Ability to work efficiently and accurately from a defined brief while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
8. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple content production requirements simultaneously.
9. Excellent professional English communication skills are required. Additional European languages are an advantage.
10. A strong interest in automotive products and technology.

小米-7670892445827369266.title: Linux内核工程师（内存方向）
小米-7670892445827369266.description:
1. 负责 Linux 内核内存管理子系统的架构设计与技术预研,跟踪上游社区最新
进展,评估新特性的引入价值与落地可行性
2. 针对手机平台的内存资源约束与使用场景,设计并实现内存管理优化方案,
提升系统整体内存利用效率与用户体验
3. 深入分析内存分配、回收、压缩、交换等核心路径的性能瓶颈,提出并落地
优化策略
4. 负责内存相关疑难问题的定位与解决,包括但不限于 OOM、内存泄漏、
内存碎片化、性能劣化等
5. 构建内存管理相关的测试、度量与监控体系,驱动内存性能的持续改进
6. 与上下游团队（调度、文件系统、驱动、框架层）紧密协作,推动端到端的
系统级优化
小米-7670892445827369266.requirements:
基本要求
1. 计算机科学、电子工程或相关专业本科及以上学历,具有 Linux 内核
开发经验
2. 扎实的操作系统理论基础,深入理解虚拟内存管理、物理内存分配、
页表管理、
3. 理解内存回收（LRU/MGLRU）、内存压缩（compaction）、内存
交换（swap/zram）等核心机制
4. 熟练掌握 C 语言,具备良好的内核代码阅读与编写能力
5. 熟悉 Linux 内核调试工具与方法（ftrace、perf、kprobe、crash 等）,
能使用工具定位内核问题
6. 具备良好的英文读写能力,能够阅读与参与上游社区讨论

优先条件
1. 有 Linux 内核社区贡献经历（提交过 patch 并被合入主线）
2. 有手机/嵌入式平台 Linux 内核开发与优化经验,熟悉 Android
内存管理框架（lowmemorykiller/lmkd、ion/dma-buf 等）
3. 熟悉 NUMA、CMA、HugePage、DAMON、Memory Tiering 
等内存管理特性
4. 有内存管理子系统架构设计的相关项目经验

小米-7670891732023888155.title: NPI 项目经理-手机
小米-7670891732023888155.description:
1、负责新品全生命周期制造领域的管理和经营，新品阶段负责新品（立项-TR6）导入到制造端的项目管理工作，衔接研发与制造，负责新产品导入工作，统筹新产品的试产爬坡管理工作，对项目整体交付（进度、质量、成本）负责；
2、负责产品在代工厂/自有工厂的试产爬坡项目管理工作，确保产品能在各个工厂进行试产爬坡，平稳转量产；
3、匹配产品的开发和发布节奏，制定新产品制造策略，监控产品爬坡产能状况，保障新产品首量交付；
4、负责制定新产品试产计划与达成，负责生产成熟度和良率的验证及提升，负责项目指标的达成甚至优于基线，确保新产品技术评审过点达成、产品达成量产状态；
5、负责新品导入流程的持续改进，制定相关流程和文档，并完成评审与发行；
6、利用外围业务模块的资源及数据，对产品数据及生产过程进行分析，识别改善机会点，分配任务，推动各业务模块行动及落实并取得收益。
小米-7670891732023888155.requirements:
1、本科及以上，机械、通讯、计算机、电子信息、管理等相关专业；成绩排名前列，并且获得过校园奖学金或国家奖学金优先考虑录用，面试成绩优秀同学可考虑破格录用；
2、具备积极正向的工作、生活价值观，优秀的语言表达与沟通能力和工作热情；逻辑思路清晰，具备较强的沟通协调、组织决策、推动能力，良好的学习能力；有过校园社团实践、企业实习并且取得优秀成绩的优先考虑录用；
3、具备良好的办公软件使用能力，良好的归纳分析、判断、总结和写作能力，能够完成信息有效提炼整合，且实现良好的演讲汇报最佳；
4、熟练的办公软件使用能力，优先计算机二级和大学英语6级及以上。

小米-7670935050502998298.title: New Retail Management Trainee-local
小米-7670935050502998298.description:
1.热情接待顾客，了解顾客需求，提供专业的产品咨询和推荐与服务演示。
2.熟练掌握门店所有产品知识，包括功能、配置、价格等，并能清晰地向顾客讲解。
3.积极完成个人销售目标，并协助团队达成门店销售指标。
4.处理顾客投诉和售后问题，提供优质的售后服务，维护顾客关系。
5.维护小米品牌和店面的形象。保持门店环境整洁，商品陈列整齐，营造良好的购物氛围。
6.积极参与公司组织的培训和活动，不断提升自身销售技巧和产品知识。
7.完成上级领导交办的其他任务。
1. Warmly receive customers, understand customer needs, and provide professional product consultation, recommendations and service demonstrations.
2. Proficient in all product knowledge in the store, including functions, configuration, prices, etc., and can clearly explain to customers.
3. Actively complete personal sales targets and assist the team to achieve store sales targets.
4. Handle customer complaints and after-sales problems, provide high-quality after-sales services, and maintain customer relationships.
5. Maintain the image of the Xiaomi brand and storefront. Keep the store environment clean, display the products neatly, and create a good shopping atmosphere.
6. Actively participate in the company organized training and activities, and continuously improve sales techniques and product knowledge.
7. Complete other tasks assigned by leaders.

小米-7670934764413045028.description:
Oversee timely store construction, managing site selection, design, decoration and opening end-to-end; coordinate internal teams to ensure on-time, high-quality project delivery.
Manage store operations by implementing strategies for staffing, inventory and customer service to optimize efficiency and quality; execute sales/promotional plans to boost brand image and performance; monitor data to adjust strategies for goal achievement.
Lead store team management and training, developing plans to enhance overall team quality and service standards.
Conduct regular market research on competitors and trends to inform store development; analyze customer feedback and propose improvements to elevate experience.,1. Provide superior customer experience: Receive customers warmly and friendly, understand their needs, and provide personalized solutions that exceed their expectations.
2. Product experts: In-depth understanding of all Xiaomi product hardware and software knowledge, service knowledge, and being able to explain its functions and advantages to customers clearly and concisely, is the person of the store team to learn and find product help.
3. Sales and service: Actively listen to customer needs, recommend suitable products and services, complete store sales targets, and be able to handle customer consultation and technical support at the same time.
4. Teamwork: Work closely with team members to create a positive working atmosphere and provide customers with a seamless service experience.
5. Assist store management: Assist the store manager in managing the daily operations of the store, such as sales analysis, display arrangement, customer service, inventory, and activity formulation and execution.
6. Keep learning: Actively participate in the company organized training, and constantly learn new product knowledge, sales techniques and service concepts to maintain a leading position.

小米-7582500973826935103.description:
1. Budget Planning: Develop and manage the workplace support services budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and adherence to financial guidelines. 
2. Contract Management: Oversee the management of contracts with vendors and service providers, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions and facilitating renewals or modifications as necessary. 
3. Vendor Management: Establish and maintain relationships with third-party service providers and vendors, ensuring high-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations. 
4. Project Management: Lead and coordinate workplace-related projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. 
5. Reporting: Prepare and present reports on workplace utilization, performance metrics, and improvement initiatives to management, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making. 
6. Liaison with Building Management: Act as the primary point of contact with building management, ensuring effective communication and collaboration on workplace-related matters. 
7. Process and Cost-Driven Execution: Demonstrate a process-driven and cost-effective approach to workplace support services, ensuring that all tasks are executed efficiently and effectively. 
8. Support for In-House Events: Provide logistical support for in-house events, including setup, coordination, and post-event evaluations to ensure successful execution.

1. Bachelor’s degree in Workplace Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 
2. Minimum of 3 years of experience in workplace support services or a related field. 
3. Strong knowledge of budget management, procurement processes, and vendor relations. 
4. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with advanced Excel skills. 
5. Able to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels of sophistication. 
6. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and efficiently juggle numerous concurrent responsibilities. 
7. Develop and maintain productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

1. Budget Planning: Develop and manage the workplace support services budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and adherence to financial guidelines. 
2. Contract Management: Oversee the management of contracts with vendors and service providers, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions and facilitating renewals or modifications as necessary. 
3. Vendor Management: Establish and maintain relationships with third-party service providers and vendors, ensuring high-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations. 
4. Project Management: Lead and coordinate workplace-related projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. 
5. Reporting: Prepare and present reports on workplace utilization, performance metrics, and improvement initiatives to management, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making. 
6. Liaison with Building Management: Act as the primary point of contact with building management, ensuring effective communication and collaboration on workplace-related matters. 
7. Process and Cost-Driven Execution: Demonstrate a process-driven and cost-effective approach to workplace support services, ensuring that all tasks are executed efficiently and effectively. 
8. Support for In-House Events: Provide logistical support for in-house events, including setup, coordination, and post-event evaluations to ensure successful execution.
小米-7582851706787596570.requirements:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Workplace Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 
2. Minimum of 3 years of experience in workplace support services or a related field. 
3. Strong knowledge of budget management, procurement processes, and vendor relations. 
4. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with advanced Excel skills. 
5. Able to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels of sophistication. 
6. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and efficiently juggle numerous concurrent responsibilities. 
7. Develop and maintain productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

小米-7685314666084141348.title: Operations Support Manager
小米-7685314666084141348.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

Office & Administrative Operations
1. Oversee day-to-day operations of the regional office, including facilities, administrative services, and logistics.
2. Develop, implement, and continuously improve office management processes, systems, and guidelines.
3. Manage office procurement, suppliers, service providers, and related cost controls.
4. Ensure office operations comply with applicable local laws, regulations, and internal requirements, including areas such as health and safety, security, and environmental standards.
5. Coordinate office events, employee activities, and other organizational initiatives.
Project Management & Coordination
1. Act as a project management lead for selected strategic initiatives across the organization and drive projects toward timely completion.
2. Coordinate cross-functional collaboration between regional and European teams as well as global headquarters.
3. Establish project timelines, track milestones, identify dependencies, and provide regular progress updates.
4. Support end-to-end management of selected commercial projects, including business-term coordination, contract review, legal alignment, execution, and documentation.
5. Identify project risks and dependencies at an early stage, provide appropriate escalation, and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.
Asset Management
1. Manage the full lifecycle of fixed and intangible assets across the organization.
2. Maintain accurate asset records and coordinate regular inventory checks.
3. Oversee asset procurement, allocation, maintenance, transfer, and disposal processes.
4. Develop and maintain appropriate asset management standards and controls.
5. Monitor asset-related costs and identify opportunities for operational efficiency.
Cross-functional Business Support
1. Work closely with Network Development, GTM, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and other functions to provide operational and project support.
2. Coordinate administrative and operational requirements across departments.
3. Support cross-functional coordination related to compliance, legal, finance, and other business processes.
4. Help establish efficient ways of working across the growing European organization.
小米-7685314666084141348.requirements:
【Requirements】

1. 5+ years of experience in operations management, business operations, project management, or a related field.
2. Experience supporting operations within a multinational, international, or fast-growing organization is highly desirable.
3. Professional fluency in English, Chinese language skills are a clear advantage.
4. Strong project management capabilities; PMP or an equivalent qualification is an advantage.
5. Familiarity with European office operations, asset management processes, and relevant compliance requirements.
6. Excellent cross-functional communication, coordination, organizational, and prioritization skills.
7. Proficiency in common office management, collaboration, and project management tools.
8. Experience supporting or managing operations in a European environment is highly desirable.
9. Experience within the automotive, mobility, technology, or another complex operational environment is an advantage.
10. Experience with commercial contract coordination and collaboration with legal teams.
11. Strong cost awareness and experience managing suppliers and service providers.
12. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

小米-7684097441260062982.description:
1、参与制定英国分期业务发展规划，负责分期产品的市场调研、用户需求分析、产品设计、产品迭代；

2、负责与英国银行/租赁机构对接、招采、运营、管理；

3、制定英国汽车金融产品定制开发、上线、迭代管理制度、政策；

小米-7659304213025016091.description:
1. PatchWall内容本地化运营：负责印度内容CP的日常沟通与关系维护，推进内容合作落地；策划并执行本地节日、赛事等重点运营活动；跟踪本地内容趋势与用户偏好，输出品类策略建议，优化分发效率
2.电视应用商店运营：制定并执行应用分发策略；对接印度本地开发者及CP，推动应用上架与质量管控；监控核心指标，输出优化建议

1.PatchWall content localization: Manage daily communication and relationships with Indian content partners, driving content collaboration; plan and execute key campaigns around local festivals, sports events, and other trending moments; track local content trends and user preferences, deliver category strategy recommendations, and optimize distribution efficiency
2.TV App store operations: Develop and execute app distribution strategies; liaise with Indian developers and CPs to drive app onboarding and quality control; monitor core metrics and deliver optimization recommendations
3.Lock screen operations: Plan and manage gallery content and assets; develop distribution strategies, track performance, and continuously optimize
小米-7659304213025016091.requirements:
1.本科及以上学历，2年以上互联网内容或应用分发相关工作经验
2.英文及印度本地任一语言（印地语，泰米尔语，泰卢固等）母语水平
3.对印度各区域文化差异有深刻理解，熟悉印度内容生态与主流媒体/娱乐格局，了解OTT、短视频等内容形态
4.跨文化沟通能力强，自驱力强
1.Bachelor's degree or above, 2+ years of experience in internet content operations or app distribution
2.Native-level proficiency in English and at least one Indian language (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, etc.)
3.Deep understanding of regional cultural differences across India, familiar with India's content ecosystem and mainstream media/entertainment landscape, including OTT, short video, and other content formats
4.Strong cross-cultural communication skills and self-driven mindset

小米-7665156726169667883.description:
岗位职责：
1、负责阳台储能、户用光储一体机品类质量管理，新产品研发阶段质量管控，覆盖立项、方案设计、样机验证、试产、量产导入全流程，搭建《质量验收标准》
2、主导全流程质量问题闭环，包含但不限于，研发阶段可靠性测试、试产问题、内测问题、安规、EMC、温升、老化、高低温、等质量验证，输出质量风险评估报告，闭环解决研发阶段各项问题。
3、负责阳台储能产品BMS、PCS逆变模块、锂电池Pack、整机电源系统的研发质量评审，包含PCB、BOM、器件选型、版本变更、结构散热、防护设计的质量把控，提前规避批量质量隐患。
4、跟进样机调试、试产问题，主导根因定位、整改验证、经验沉淀，推动研发、结构、供应链、测试团队完成问题闭环。
5、熟悉阳台储能行业国内外认证标准（CE、UL、IEC、并网安规、电磁兼容），配合完成认证测试工作
小米-7665156726169667883.requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，电子信息、自动化、新能源、电气相关专业优先，2年以上阳台储能/户用光储一体机研发/质量管理经验，有完整新品从研发到量产落地经验优先。
2、熟悉阳台储能整机架构、BMS策略、PCS逆变原理、能够快速推动各环节质量问题整改，了解储能行业安规、及可靠性标准。
3、熟悉锂电储能、电源类产品常见失效模式：过热、异响、干扰、纹波超标、充断异常、老化衰减、结构防护失效等，可独立完成问题复盘与整改落地。
4、逻辑清晰、执行力强，要求高度的责任心，具备优秀的跨部门协同、问题分析与闭环能力，能承受研发项目进度压力。

小米-7480839320724422765.title: Product&Compliance Intern
小米-7480839320724422765.description:
Job Description

Compliance Management & Certification Execution: Assist the team in the local compliance management of all Xiaomi products (including smartphones, wearables, smart home products, lifestyle products, smart TVs and big appliances). Assist in the product certification process (including TSE, BTK, KKDIK),follow-up routine processes. Assist in the compliance review of product-related documents (user manuals, regulatory documents, stickers, etc.) and packaging materials.

Regulatory Research & Closed-loop Management: Assist in monitoring and collecting Turkish local product-related regulations and standards, and sort out materials related to regulatory interpretation, impact evaluation and product project implementation in a standardized manner.

Change Assessment: Assist in evaluating the scope of compliance impact during the project ECN phase, and provide basic compliance support for business decision-making with team guidance.

Database Development & Maintenance: Assist in building and continuously updating the local cross-category product compliance requirement database, and be responsible for daily data sorting, entry and maintenance.
小米-7480839320724422765.requirements:
Qualifications & Requirements

Have a basic understanding of product compliance and certification logic, and a strong learning willingness for Turkish local regulatory systems such as TSE, BTK and KKDIK.

Possess basic abilities in information collection and document sorting, with the potential to learn and interpret regulatory standards quickly.

Excellent English communication and coordination skills, with a strong sense of team cooperation; able to effectively match cross-departmental work and complete basic project execution.

小米-7511630019904897133.description:
1. Lead smartphone product management, including product planning, go-to-market (GTM) strategy development, and channel management for new product launches.
2. Conduct in-depth market research and competitor analysis, manage the entire product lifecycle, and take ownership of product sales performance.
3. Define key product value propositions and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop effective marketing and communication strategies.
4. Manage product pricing, demand planning, and PSI (Purchase, Sales & Inventory) to maximize profitability while maintaining healthy market order and inventory levels.
5. Plan and manage product marketing budgets, ensuring marketing resources are aligned with product strategy to maximize ROI and sustain product momentum throughout the lifecycle.

1. Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related discipline.
2. At least 3 years of experience in the consumer electronics industry, preferably in Product Management, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market (GTM), or Sales. 
3. Strong understanding of the Singapore market and sales channels, with proven experience in successful product launches and channel management.
4. Strong commercial acumen with excellent market insight and analytical skills, able to quickly translate market feedback into actionable business strategies.
5. Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and deliver results.

小米-7678625315527412018.title: Regional Head
小米-7678625315527412018.description:
岗位职责：
全面负责大区销售目标及零售市场份额，对独立零售渠道（IR）、重点客户渠道（KA）及新零售渠道的进货（SI）、销售流转（ST）和终端销售（SO）业绩负责。
根据公司整体业务目标，制定大区销售策略、年度业务计划及执行方案，并推动各城市、渠道和客户落实。
全面负责大区预算及费用管理，合理规划、控制并评估各项资源投入，确保预算使用效率和业务投入产出。
全面负责大区组织管理、客户管理、门店运营、零售阵地、物流及导购团队管理，确保各项运营指标达成。
全面负责大区组织建设，包括组织架构规划、人员招聘、绩效管理、能力培养及人员日常工作管理。
监控大区销售表现、零售市场份额、渠道库存、价格体系及竞品动态，并及时制定和落实改善措施。
联动市场、零售、产品及供应链团队，推动新品上市、大型促销活动、门店拓展及终端零售执行。
负责大区核心经销商、零售商及其他业务合作伙伴的开发、维护和管理，建立长期稳定的合作关系。
负责大区销售预测、产品分配、库存补充及物流协调，保障产品供应，并维持健康的渠道库存水平。
持续提升门店覆盖率、产品陈列、品牌形象、导购效率及门店产出，强化小米在重点零售阵地的竞争力。

全面负责大区预算及费用管理，合理规划、控制并评估各项资源投入，确保预算使用效率和业务投入产出。
全面负责大区组织管理、客户管理、门店运营、零售阵地、物流及导购团队管理，确保各项运营指标达成。
全面负责大区组织建设，包括组织架构规划、人员招聘、绩效管理、能力培养及人员日常工作管理。
监控大区销售表现、零售市场份额、渠道库存、价格体系及竞品动态，并及时制定和落实改善措施。
联动市场、零售、产品及供应链团队，推动新品上市、大型促销活动、门店拓展及终端零售执行。
负责大区核心经销商、零售商及其他业务合作伙伴的开发、维护和管理，建立长期稳定的合作关系。
负责大区销售预测、产品分配、库存补充及物流协调，保障产品供应，并维持健康的渠道库存水平。
持续提升门店覆盖率、产品陈列、品牌形象、导购效率及门店产出，强化小米在重点零售阵地的竞争力。

任职要求：
1.10年以上销售行业工作经验，5年以上区域管理经验，有手机行业经验者优先。
2.本科及以上学历。
3.英语可作为工作语言，会中文加分
4.掌握项目管理能力，能够高效推动各项任务落地。

小米-7704961386610805001.title: Regional Marketing Director
小米-7704961386610805001.description:
一、 岗位职责 (Job Responsibilities)
1. 品牌战略与本地化落地 (Brand Strategy & Localization)
结合小米集团全球品牌愿景（Global Vision）与中东地区（特别是GCC海湾国家及重点新兴市场）的本地市场动态，制定并执行全方位的品牌与市场营销战略。领导并推动小米“手机 × AIoT”全生态产品（智能手机、智能穿戴、智能家居等）在中东市场的整合营销，持续提升小米及高端子品牌在中东高端消费群体中的品牌认知度（Brand Awareness）与美誉度。   
2. 本地营销战役与新品上市 (Campaigns & Product Launches)
全面统筹中东区年度重大新品发布会、节日营销（如斋月 Ramadan、开斋节、黑色星期五/White Friday 购物季等）及大型跨界营销活动。结合中东多元的文化背景，打造兼具全球视野与极强本地共鸣的创意内容与公关传播方案。
3. 数字营销、社群生态与媒介矩阵 (Digital Marketing & Social Ecosystem)
负责中东区数字营销战略，统筹 SEO/SEM、主流社交媒体（如 Instagram, TikTok, X, Snapchat, YouTube）官方矩阵的运营与私域流量构建。   深化与中东当地顶级科技KOL、生活方式名流及跨界品牌的深度合作（Influencer Marketing），建立长期且具有高投资回报率（ROI）的达人生态。
4. 渠道协同与零售营销 (Channel & Retail/Visual Marketing)
紧密协同销售团队（Sales Team），支持小米之家（Mi Store）、核心运营商渠道以及电商平台（如 Noon, Amazon ME）的零售视觉（Visual Merchandising）与终端陈列规范，实现品效合一。制定针对不同渠道（线上/线下/运营商/零售商）的联合营销（Co-marketing）方案，最大化营销预算效能。   
5. 团队管理与本地化建设 (Team Leadership & Localization)   
组建、管理并赋能跨国、多元文化背景的市场团队（包含公关PR、数字营销、活动策划、视觉设计等职能）。   
建立高效的市场运营机制，管理第三方创意、公关及媒介代理商，对中东区整体市场预算的分配与ROI负最终责任
小米-7704961386610805001.requirements:
1. 教育背景 (Education)
本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告学、企业管理、国际贸易或相关专业优先。
2. 工作经验 (Experience)
具备 8年及以上 消费电子、智能硬件、互联网或头部出海科技品牌的市场营销经验，其中至少 3-5年 在跨国企业担任区域市场总监或核心管理岗位。   有中东地区实战操盘经验者必须具备，熟悉沙特阿拉伯（KSA）、阿联酋（UAE）等核心市场的法律法规、商业习惯与主流媒体生态。   
3. 专业能力 (Professional Skills)
全案营销能力：拥有成功主导现象级新品发布、大型跨区域品牌战役（Brand Campaigns）的操盘记录。   精通数字营销、社群运营、大数据分析及媒介投放策略。渠道协同经验：具备与大型零售商（Retailers）、电信运营商（Operators）及主流电商平台协同作战的成功经验。
4. 核心素养与领导力 (Leadership & Soft Skills)
卓越的领导力与跨文化管理能力：能够驾驭多元文化团队，在快节奏、高压力的国际化环境中高效驱动跨部门协作（商务、产品、供应链等）。   商务谈判与危机公关能力：具备极强的商务拓展意识及出色的突发事件公关处理能力，注重合规性与文化标准。   
5. 语言要求 (Language)
英语可作为卓越的工作语言（听说读写流利）

小米-7694220684474124585.title: Retail Excellence Trainer (DE)
小米-7694220684474124585.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

1.Deliver engaging and effective product, sales, customer experience and retail-process training to Xiaomi frontline teams and partner networks.
2.Act as the primary Retail Capability training contact for Germany, ensuring European learning programmes are effectively deployed and understood in the local market.
3.Deliver classroom, virtual, in-store and practical vehicle training using the appropriate format for each learning requirement.
4.Support new vehicle launches, store openings, system deployments and major commercial or customer-experience initiatives.
5.Develop deep expertise in Xiaomi vehicles, technologies, ecosystem, competitors and customer propositions, and translate this knowledge into compelling frontline learning.
6.Deliver practical sales training and coaching covering customer engagement, needs discovery, product presentation, vehicle and ecosystem demonstration, test drives, objection handling, configuration, decision support and closing.
7.Support frontline onboarding, assessments and certification, ensuring required competence levels are achieved ahead of operational deployment.
8.Provide targeted coaching and refresher interventions where capability or performance gaps are identified.
9.Gather structured feedback from trainees, stores, partners and field observations, and provide actionable insights to the European Retail Capability team.
10.Support the localisation of European learning programmes where market requirements differ, while maintaining European consistency.
11.Support training activities in other European markets where required, particularly during launches or periods of increased capability demand.
12.Participate in Train-the-Trainer programmes and support future trainers as the European network expands.
13.Maintain accurate training participation, assessment, certification and effectiveness records, and contribute to European reporting.
14.Work closely with Retail Experience & Standards, Partner Operations, Sales Operations and Product teams to ensure training remains connected to operational reality.
小米-7694220684474124585.requirements:
【What We're Looking For】

1.Strong experience delivering automotive sales, product or customer-experience training, ideally within an OEM, importer or dealer-network environment.
2.Previous frontline automotive sales experience is highly desirable, and the ability to build credibility quickly with Sales Advisors and retail teams is essential.
3.Strong knowledge of and genuine enthusiasm for cars, automotive technology and the European automotive market.
4.Excellent facilitation, communication, presentation and coaching skills across classroom, virtual and practical learning environments.
5.Strong understanding of automotive sales processes and the ability to connect product knowledge with customer needs and commercial outcomes.
6.Ability to explain complex vehicle technologies in clear, simple and commercially relevant customer language.
7.Comfortable using digital learning platforms, presentation tools and modern training technologies.
8.Excellent professional German and English are mandatory. Other European languages are desirable.
9.Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working with European HQ, market teams and external retail partners.
10.Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and regularly across Europe when required.

小米-7700884888949934378.title: Sales Steering Manager
小米-7700884888949934378.description:
【Responsibilities】

1. Develop the European sales steering approach, defining the commercial levers and interventions used to support sales performance across markets, products and channels.
2. Design and coordinate sales programmes and promotional activities in response to business objectives, market opportunities and performance requirements.
3. Use sales plans, forecasts and business insights to identify volume gaps, demand opportunities and areas requiring commercial intervention.
4. Develop promotional proposals including objectives, target customers, eligible products, mechanics, timing and expected commercial impact.
5. Coordinate European-wide programmes while enabling appropriate market-level adaptation based on local performance, customer needs and competitive conditions.
6. Partner with Finance and relevant stakeholders to evaluate programme economics, affordability and expected return before implementation.
7. Coordinate with Marketing, Retail, Partner Operations, Product and local market teams to ensure promotional activities are effectively communicated and executed across customer-facing channels.
8. Establish clear performance measures for sales programmes and work with Business Analytics to evaluate effectiveness, customer response and incremental commercial impact.
9. Maintain visibility of active and planned commercial programmes across Europe, ensuring activities are coordinated and potential conflicts or overlaps are identified.
10. Continuously improve sales steering approaches based on programme performance, market feedback and evolving business requirements.
小米-7700884888949934378.requirements:
【What we're looking for】

1. Proven experience in sales steering, commercial strategy, sales programmes, commercial planning or a related role, ideally within automotive or another high-value consumer business.
2. Strong commercial understanding with experience developing promotional activities, sales programmes or other commercial interventions designed to influence customer demand and sales performance.
3. Strong understanding of the relationship between volume, demand, pricing, incentives, customer behaviour and commercial performance.
4. Analytical and commercially minded, with the ability to use forecasts and performance insights to identify where intervention is required and determine appropriate actions.
5. Experience developing business cases and evaluating the financial and commercial impact of promotional programmes.
6. Strong programme management capability, with the ability to coordinate initiatives across multiple markets, products and channels.
7. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Retail and local market teams.
8. Comfortable balancing European consistency with different market conditions and commercial requirements.
9. Proactive and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where market conditions and business priorities can change quickly.
10. Fluent English required, Mandarin language proficiency is desirable to support effective collaboration with Global Headquarters in China.

小米-7694221093885167913.title: Senior Learning Content Designer
小米-7694221093885167913.description:
Responsibilities:
-  Develop and continuously improve learning content across product and technology, brand, sales, customer experience and retail operations. 
-  Translate complex product and technology information into clear customer benefits, sales narratives and relevant frontline knowledge. 
-  Independently structure learning modules from business requirements, product documentation and subject-matter input, determining the appropriate storyline, content hierarchy and level of detail. 
-  Develop vehicle-launch training, product highlights, competitor comparisons, sales tools, facilitator guides, job aids, quick-reference materials and digital learning assets. 
-  Build modular learning content supporting onboarding, certification, product launches, refreshers and continuous development. 
-  Define learning objectives, module structures, knowledge checks, exercises and supporting assessment content where required. 
-  Work closely with Product, Retail Capability, Sales Operations and subject-matter experts to ensure content is factually accurate, commercially relevant and appropriate for frontline audiences. 
-  Translate approved competitor intelligence and market information into useful comparison and positioning materials for sales teams. 
-  Maintain a consistently high standard of visual storytelling, information design and communication across all learning assets. 
-  Support LMS system, classroom, virtual, digital and blended-learning formats and ensure content can be effectively scaled across European markets. 
-  Continuously update materials based on product changes, market developments, frontline feedback and evolving business priorities. 
-  Support the governance, version control and localisation of European learning content.
小米-7694221093885167913.requirements:
What we're looking for:
-  Strong experience developing automotive product, sales, commercial or customer-facing learning content, ideally within an OEM, importer, dealer network or automotive consultancy. 
-  Strong understanding of cars, automotive technologies and the European automotive market. 
-  Ability to interpret complex product or business information and independently determine what matters to a frontline retail audience and how it should be communicated. 
-  Strong understanding of learning principles and the ability to structure content around clear learning outcomes rather than simply presenting information. 
-  Excellent product storytelling, copywriting and information-structuring capability. 
-  Strong visual storytelling and presentation-design capability. 
-  Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint and strong familiarity with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent. 
-  Experience with video production, editing, motion graphics, digital learning or emerging content-creation technologies is highly desirable. 
-  Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with product specifications, technology and competitor information. 
-  Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working directly with subject-matter experts. 
-  Excellent professional English is mandatory. German highly desirable, such as additional European languages. 
-  Genuine passion for automotive products and technology.

小米-7524161034393010285.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Germany
小米-7524161034393010285.description:
The Role:

We are looking for a passionate Legal Counsel responsible for our European Automotive Business Line in a highly dynamic and international environment. The position will be based in Munich (Germany).

You will support the automotive business of Xiaomi with your proven expertise and pragmatic, business oriented and pro-active advice. 

The position is the first of its kind in Europe dedicated to Xiaomi's Automotive Business Line. Therefore, we are looking for an experienced generalist who has rich experience in the automotive industry (preferably OEM). The ideal candidate may develop into a team leader role managing additional Legal Counsel across Europe supporting Xiaomi´s European Automotive Business Line.

The position will include the following tasks:
1. Legal Advice and Research on Laws and Regulations.
2. Draft, Review and Negotiate a wide variety of national and international contracts.
3. Drafting of Guidelines, Policies and Templates.
4. Review of Marketing Material and Marketing Campaigns.
5. Communication with Regulatory Authorities.
6. Coordination of disputes and claims, including managing external counsels
Support and advice to the finance, tax, sales and HR department.
7. Liaise with the HQ Legal Team.
小米-7524161034393010285.requirements:
Candidate Profile:
1. German Bar Exam (Second State Examination).
2. Minimum 4 years of experience gained as an in-house lawyer in the automotive industry.
3. Full proficiency in German and English.
4. Strong commercial sense and pragmatism.
5. Being able to prioritize and handle tight deadlines.

小米-7685314705992649023.title: Senior Marketing Manager
小米-7685314705992649023.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

Brand & PR Strategy
1. Develop and execute Xiaomi EV’s brand communication and PR strategy for the markets.
2. Shape a clear and differentiated brand narrative aligned with Xiaomi EV’s business and market positioning.
3. Ensure consistency between global brand strategy, European communications and the markets.
4. Translate strategic priorities into effective communication plans across relevant markets.
Media Relations & Reputation Management
1. Build and maintain strong relationships with leading automotive and technology media, industry stakeholders, and relevant opinion leaders.
2. Plan and execute high-impact PR activities, including product launches, media test drives, industry events, and exhibitions.
3. Monitor market sentiment and media coverage across relevant markets and proactively identify communication opportunities and risks.
4. Develop and implement crisis communication approaches in close collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
Market Communication & Campaign Execution
1. Work closely with local commercial partners to develop and implement market-relevant communication and marketing plans.
2. Lead or coordinate advertising, content marketing, digital communication, and other brand-building initiatives across markets.
3. Support global product launch communication plans and ensure effective local market execution.
4. Continuously evaluate communication effectiveness and adapt activities based on market insights and performance.
Team & Agency Management
1. Build and develop the regional Marketing and PR function as the organization scales.
2. Manage external PR, advertising, and communication agencies and strategic partners.
3. Establish effective cross-functional collaboration with GTM, Network Development, Operations Support, and other relevant functions.
4. Foster an efficient and collaborative working model across local and global teams.
小米-7685314705992649023.requirements:
【Requirements】

1. 8+ years of experience in brand marketing, PR, or marketing communications, preferably within the automotive, mobility, or technology sector.
2. At least 3 years of professional experience working with European markets and stakeholders.
3. Professional fluency in English, additional European language skills are an advantage.
4. Strong understanding of the European automotive and technology media landscape and relevant communication requirements.
5. Proven experience in launching or establishing a brand, product, or business in a new European market.
6. Experience working within an importer, agency, partner-led, or other indirect distribution model is highly desirable.
7. Experience supporting the European/Country market entry or growth of an international automotive or technology brand is highly desirable.
8. Experience in NEV/EV brand building or automotive mobility communications is a strong advantage.
9. Established relationships with relevant automotive and technology media and industry stakeholders across multiple markets.
10. Good understanding of EU advertising, data protection, and automotive industry compliance requirements.
11. Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and execution capabilities.

2. Conduct regular partner and dealer visits to understand operational performance and identify improvement opportunities.

4. Drive continuous improvement in partner capabilities, operational standards, and customer experience.
Site Selection & Retail Development

1. Build and develop the Network Development team as the organization scales.
2. Strengthen local network development capabilities, market knowledge, and partner relationships.
3. Collaborate closely with GTM, Marketing, Operations Support, and other functions to enable integrated market expansion.

小米-7694852073531394354.title: Senior PR Manager – Northern & Eastern Europe
小米-7694852073531394354.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

Regional PR Execution
1.Develop and execute PR plans for Northern & Eastern European markets within the framework of the overall European PR strategy.
2.Lead the execution of regional communications initiatives, including product launches, brand activities, media drive events, and other PR projects.
3.Work closely with local distributor marketing and PR teams to support market-specific communications activities and initiatives.
Local Media Relations
1.Build and maintain relationships with key automotive and technology media, as well as relevant KOLs, across Northern & Eastern European markets.
2.Organize local media briefings, interviews, media drive events, and other media engagement activities.
3.Manage the localization and distribution of regional press releases and other media communications materials.
Media & Public Sentiment Monitoring and Crisis Support
1.Monitor the media and public sentiment landscape across Northern & Eastern European markets and promptly escalate relevant negative or potentially sensitive developments.
2.Support the Head of Northern & Eastern Europe in implementing regional crisis communications plans and response mechanisms.
3.Prepare regular regional media and public sentiment reports, including weekly and monthly updates.
Content Localization & Communications Materials
1.Coordinate the localization and adaptation of PR materials, including press releases, media materials, FAQs, and other communications content.
2.Support the development and review of regional social media content from a PR and communications perspective.
小米-7694852073531394354.requirements:
【Required Qualifications】

1.5-8 years of experience in automotive PR, communications, or brand communications, including 2–3 years of experience working with Northern & Eastern European or Nordic markets.
2.Professional fluency in English. German, a Nordic language such as Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish, or Polish or Czech is a plus.
3.Strong understanding of the media landscape and PR and communications environment across Northern & Eastern Europe.
4.Demonstrated experience in automotive PR execution, with the ability to independently coordinate and deliver regional PR projects.
5.Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with a hands-on and effective approach to execution.

【Preferred Qualifications】

1.Experience supporting PR and communications activities for Chinese brands entering Northern & Eastern European markets.
2.Established relationships with automotive media or relevant KOLs across Northern & Eastern Europe.
3.Experience in the new energy vehicle (NEV) industry.
4.Familiarity with local advertising regulations and data protection requirements.

小米-7670931024012675366.title: Service Operations Specialist-local
小米-7670931024012675366.description:
1. Spare Parts Demand Planning and Forecasting: Based on historical data, product lifecycle, and market feedback, develop monthly/quarterly spare parts demand forecasting plans and collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure spare parts supply.

2. Inventory Operations Management: Monitor spare parts inventory levels at warehouses and service stations nationwide, regularly generate inventory health reports (turnover rate, stockout rate, obsolete percentage), and promote the consumption of obsolete spare parts and the disposal of defective products; dynamically optimize safety stock strategies to balance supply timeliness and inventory holding costs.

3. Data Monitoring and System Operation: Operate the spare parts management information system, maintaining the accuracy of spare parts master data and inventory data; regularly generate weekly/monthly spare parts operation reports, track key indicators (on-time delivery rate, order fulfillment rate, inventory age distribution), identify data anomalies, and drive resolution.

4. Cross-Departmental Coordination: Coordinate with after-sales service outlets, quality, product, finance, and other departments to resolve unexpected issues in spare parts supply; support the capacity requirements of repair services across various channels, ensuring efficient collaboration between spare parts supply and repair services.

小米-7535789083731066988.title: Store Expansion Manager-零售专项
小米-7535789083731066988.description:
1. 拓展规划：根据年度拓店目标制定门店增长规划与拓展方案。
2. 选址评估：对商圈及门店选址进行评估和谈判，对店铺位置、门店建设及租赁成本等关键指标负责。
3. 保障交付：与当地采购对接，确保建店交付能力，保障门店建设进度。
4. 客情维护：拓展物业资源，维护与地产商、Mall合作部门的关系。
5. 沙盘盘点：季度进行商圈沙盘盘点，维护商圈数据库。
6. 建店验收：根据门店建设标准及当地的法律法规协同总部、地区部与国家相关方进行门店验收。
7. 总部协同：配合执行总部建店组安排相关事项。
1. Expansion Planning: Develop store growth plans and expansion strategies in line with annual store-opening targets.
2. Evaluate Site Selection: Assess and negotiate the selection of business districts and store locations, taking responsibility for key indicators such as store location, construction, and rental costs.
3. Delivery Assurance: Coordinate with store construction suppliers to ensure delivery capabilities and maintain the construction progress of stores.
4. Partner Relations Maintenance: Expand real estate resources and maintain relationships with property developers and shopping mall cooperation departments.
5. Mapping: Conduct a quarterly mapping of business districts and maintain the business districts database.
6. Store Construction Acceptance: Inspect and accept stores with HQ and regional stakeholders based on construction standards and local laws and regulations.
7. Headquarter Coordination: Execute store establishment-related matters assigned by the HQ Expansion team.
小米-7535789083731066988.requirements:
1. 候选人需非常熟悉当地零售市场及商圈业态；
2. 具备至少3年以上当地的门店拓展经验；
3. 与本地头部及腰部商业集团、Mall、地产集团有相关合作资源且具有良好的合作关系；
4. 熟悉建筑和装修流程，了解当地法律法规和行业标准。
5. 可流畅使用本国语言及英文进行口头与书面表达。
6. 建筑、工程管理、项目管理或相关专业本科及以上学历。
7. 有头部商圈合作资源为加分项。

小米-7696059812622240063.title: Store Manager
小米-7696059812622240063.description:
【Your role】
From recruiting your team and preparing for opening to growing the business, you take ownership of commercial performance, customer experience and store operations. You combine a strong commercial mindset with hands-on leadership, coaching advisors, supporting sales and proactively acting on local market opportunities. 
Working closely with the Service Manager and European headquarters, you build a high performing team, challenge and improve ways of working, and play a major role in shaping how our customers perceive our brand in Germany. 

【Your responsibilities】
1. Lead & develop the team - recruit, onboard, coach and build a high-performing sales team with clear expectations and strong accountability.
2. Own commercial performance - deliver sales objectives, actively manage the funnel and ensure the team maximizes every customer opportunity.
3. Deliver exceptional customer experience - create a customer-first culture and ensure consistently high standards across test drive, purchase and delivery.
4. Run the store – ensure effective day-to-day operations, staffing, vehicle readiness, store standards and coordination across sales, delivery and service.
5. Drive local business development - understand the local market and develop activities that generate traffic, leads and sales.
6. Continuously improve - identify barriers to performance, test improvements and provide structured feedback to the Germany and European teams.
小米-7696059812622240063.requirements:
【What you bring】
1. Proven experience leading customer-facing teams is essential. Team Lead experience is welcome, with demonstrated results in developing people and improving sales performance.
2. Practical experience in recruitment, coaching, performance management and staff scheduling, with a willingness to support Advisors on the floor.
3. Strong knowledge of the local market, including customer needs, competitors and opportunities to develop the business.
4. An in-depth understanding of retail sales and operations, together with the ability to understand Xiaomi vehicles, their features and customer benefits, and use this knowledge to coach advisors.
5. The ability to interpret sales pipelines, cancellations, delivery performance and customer feedback, and turn findings into actions.
6. Good judgement in customer escalations, competing priorities and collaboration with service, regional leadership and European headquarters.
7. The ability to explain process and system problems clearly, propose practical improvements and assess their impact.
8. Business-fluent German and fluent English are required for communication with customers and international colleagues.
9. A valid driving licence (Class B).
10. Availability for location opening hours, including evenings and Saturdays, within a 40-hour working week. 
11. Career changers from other sectors with relevant leadership achievements and the ability and willingness to learn are explicitly welcome.

【Why join us】
1.Impact. Contribute to bringing Xiaomi's electric vehicles to Europe and shaping the customer experience.
2.Innovation. Work with a driven team that takes ownership of preparing for a successful European market launch in 2027. Contribute ideas and turn them into practical improvements for customers.
3.Growth. Build your career as we grow from a launch preparation team into an established market operation. Expansion can open opportunities for broader responsibilities and progression, based on performance, readiness and business needs.

小米-7605425349442226442.description:
1. 负责小米汽车车联网（TSP）相关产品的规划、方案设计与迭代推进，协同研发、测试、安全、合规等多方资源，推动产品高质量落地；
2. 负责产品版本规划与升级维护，输出需求清单，参与制定升级维护方案，并对交付结果进行端到端跟踪与闭环；
3. 负责需求收集与产品设计：将内外部输入的概要需求进行拆解、澄清与细化，形成可落地的产品方案、技术路线建议与需求定义，并组织需求评审；
4. 持续开展行业趋势、竞品与标杆功能研究，输出对标结论与可行的产品提升方案，推动关键能力演进；
5. 跟踪产品从设计、开发、测试到发布上线的全流程，协助把控研发进度、风险与质量，推动跨团队按期交付；
6. 负责部分海外区域需求对接与协同交付，推动多语言/多区域能力适配，支持海外项目按计划落地。

2. 热爱互联网、热爱汽车、热爱思考，具备强用户视角、结构化思维与持续创新能力；
3. 具备扎实的产品基本功：需求分析、产品规划、PRD/原型输出能力，熟悉常见原型与协作工具（Axure/墨刀/Figma 等）；
4. 具备良好的技术理解能力，能与开发团队高效沟通，能够有效推动跨部门合作；
5. 有车联网/物联网/互联网复杂平台产品经验者优先；熟悉敏捷研发流程与项目管理方法，具备里程碑管理、风险识别与推进交付能力；
6. 有海外业务经验、英文沟通能力较好者优先。

小米-7546652942851555436.title: Talent Pool-AIoT拉美
小米-7546652942851555436.description:
1、客户运营，负责对应国家或市场重点客户的AIoT产品日常运营，维护客户关系，推动新品上架与品类拓展。制定并执行客户业务计划，提升销售规模与市场覆盖。
2、跟踪客户进销存（PSI）数据，监控库存健康度、周转天数及售罄率，优化库存水平。主导月度需求预测（Forecast），协同供应链与计划团队提高预测准确性，推动补货及库存优化。
3、跟进Sell-In与Sell-Out目标，制定阶段性推进方案，确保季度/年度销售目标完成。分析销售趋势与市场动态，挖掘增长机会，定期输出经营分析报告。
4、跟踪市场价格与竞品动态，制定有竞争力的价格与促销策略。联合客户策划并执行营销活动、新品上市及大促项目，评估促销效果，优化资源投入。
5、负责销售、库存、预测等数据分析，为决策提供支持。协同销售、供应链、市场、财务等多部门，推动项目落地，优化业务流程。
小米-7546652942851555436.requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，4年以上渠道运营、KA管理、销售运营或需求计划经验，有消费电子/AIoT/智能硬件行业背景者优先；
2、英语或西班牙语（加分）可作为工作语言，跨文化沟通能力强；
3、熟悉拉美市场KA或零售渠道，有本地客户直接合作经验者优先，具备PSI管理、需求预测及销售分析实操能力；
4、数据敏感度高，熟练使用Excel、Power BI等分析工具；
5、结果导向，责任心强，能在快节奏环境下独立推动项目落地并达成业务目标。

小米-7612570977499121961.title: Tax Compliance & Accounting, Thailand
小米-7612570977499121961.description:
1. Take full responsibility for the overall tax management of Thailand region, focus on complex tax matters including tax audits and tax refund processing, and handle the company’s routine tax consultation, tax filing and other relevant tax work.
2. Provide timely financial and tax support for the new business development in Thailand, deliver localized professional financial advice, and formulate and implement tax solutions for new scenarios and business issues in local operations.
3. Lead the implementation of compliance system for the local entity in Thailand, be responsible for and support the work of external auditors, tax and other regulatory authorities, and track the resolution and closure of annual audit and financial internal control issues.
4. Be in charge of the preparation of monthly local financial reports in Thailand, and collaborate with various departments to resolve accounting issues related to local business operations.
5. Assist in the development and optimization of the company’s financial and accounting systems, and conduct standardized management of local contracts, invoices and various financial and tax files.
6. Have a deep understanding of corporate operation and cross-border transaction logic, and promote the efficient and compliant implementation of local financial and tax work through cross-departmental collaboration.
小米-7612570977499121961.requirements:
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting or related majors, with solid professional accounting foundation and proficient in Thailand local GAAP and IFRS.
2. More than 10 years of tax-related working experience, plus 3-5 years of corporate accounting experience; candidates with both in-house and agency-side tax working experience are preferred, and experience in Chinese-funded enterprises is a plus.
3. Rich practical experience in handling complex tax audit and tax refund cases in Thailand, able to independently address various difficult tax issues, and familiar with financial and tax processing related to corporate operations and cross-border transactions.
4. Have experience in undertaking corporate annual audit and financial internal control work, with professional capabilities in financial system construction and financial report preparation.
5. Excellent communication, coordination and teamwork skills, able to efficiently collaborate across departments and drive the smooth progress of work.
6. Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading and writing) as the working language; Chinese proficiency is a plus.

小米-7688617131563403566.title: Tax Manager (Automotive), Munich
小米-7688617131563403566.description:
Job Responsibilities:
As the Germany Tax Manager, support tax planning and tax advisory matters under your responsibility, including but not limited to:
- Develop overall tax planning strategies based on the Company’s business operations, transaction models and other relevant information, and coordinate their implementation.
- Assess tax risks for new business activities or special/non-routine transactions and propose appropriate solutions.
- Address and respond to tax-related questions raised by other departments within the Company, including Business, Legal, Human Resources and IT, etc.
- Monitor and analyze tax risks on a regular or ad hoc basis, and provide early warnings of significant tax risks.
- Work closely with the local finance team to implement tax solutions and support the development of tax-related systems.
- Act as the primary contact with the local tax authorities, responsible for routine communications and responding to tax authority inquiries, and actively support related to tax dispute cases.
- Support Group IFS and other projects from tax perspectives related to the relevant businesses.
- Work with external professional advisors to preform periodic tax health checks.
- Conduct regular self-assessments of significant tax risks.
- Provide tax training to frontline business and finance personnel.
小米-7688617131563403566.requirements:
Qualifications
- Strong tax analytical capabilities and the ability to apply and transfer tax knowledge across different business scenarios, with at least five years of professional experience in taxation.
- Candidates with German or broader European tax experience are welcome.
- Proficiency in both German and English, with the ability to use both languages as working languages.
- Detail-oriented and highly responsible, with excellent communication skills and an open attitude toward feedback and suggestions.
- Candidates with tax experience in the German or broader European automotive industry will be preferred.

7. 与产品、研发、客服等团队紧密协作，推动用户反馈闭环，促进以用户为中心的文化落地。

小米-7633642108850555162.title: Vehicle Mechanic
小米-7633642108850555162.description:
Role Overview
As a Mechanic in Vehicle Development, you support our engineering and validation teams in building, modifying, diagnosing, and maintaining prototype, pre-series, and series vehicles. You work closely with development engineers, test managers, and workshop partners to ensure that our test fleet is always ready for operation.
Key Responsibilities
- Build, modify, and rework development and test vehicles (mechanical systems, chassis, interior, powertrain; HV systems depending on qualification).
- Perform repairs and maintenance, including troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, and resolving mechanical issues.
- Prepare vehicles for testing activities, support vehicle evaluations, and document findings and issues.
- Conduct vehicle inspections according to manufacturer guidelines, test plans, and safety regulations.
- Document all work using digital tools.
- Support root-cause analysis and contribute technical insights to solve development-related issues.
- Maintain safety and order in the development workshop (UVV compliance, HV safety standards, tool management).
- Support vehicle transports, test bench setups and test drives (with appropriate authorization and license).
小米-7633642108850555162.requirements:
Required Qualifications
- Completed vocational training as Automotive Mechatronic Technician, Automotive Mechanic, Vehicle Technician, Industrial Mechanic, or comparable qualification.
- Ideally, experience in the prototype, testing, or development environment (OEM, Tier-1, R&D service provider).
- Strong skills in mechanical repairs, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
- High-voltage qualification (HV2 / working on HV systems) is a plus - or willingness to obtain it.
- Experience with diagnostic systems, wiring diagrams, and workshop software.
- Safe and compliant working methods according to safety and HV regulations.

Personal Skills
- Strong passion for automotive technology and development work.
- Structured, precise, and reliable way of working.
- Flexibility in working hours within a test and development environment.
- Good communication skills and ability to work in a team.
- High level of self-motivation and problem-solving ability.
- Willingness to travel

小米-7696061195665049892.title: Xiaomi Advisor
小米-7696061195665049892.description:
【Your role】
 As a Xiaomi Advisor, you own customer relationships from the first lead through vehicle handover. You understand what matters to each customer, bring Xiaomi´s vehicles and technology to life, and turn interest into sales through personalized advise and confident selling. 
You take responsibility for guiding each customer through purchase and delivery, creating an exceptional experience at every touchpoint. Working closely with Service Advisors, you ensure a smooth start to ownership, with the Service team taking responsibility for ongoing aftersales support.

【Your Responsibilities】
1. Create an exceptional customer experience - make every interaction seamless, intuitive and engaging, taking ownership of questions and issues rather than passing the customer between teams.
2. Own the customer relationship - take ownership of assigned customers from initial engagement through test drive, purchase and vehicle handover, providing proactive and personalized support throughout. 
3. Deliver sales results - understand customer needs, confidently recommend the right solution and convert opportunities into orders across vehicle, finance, leasing and trade-in propositions.
4. Bring the product to life - become an expert in Xiaomi Auto, our technology and ecosystem, delivering engaging product demonstrations and test drives tailored to the customer.
5. Operate as one team - work flexibly across the store, support colleagues and Service, maintain high retail standards and contribute ideas that improve how we serve customers.
小米-7696061195665049892.requirements:
【What you bring】
1. Curiosity about technology and the Xiaomi ecosystem, with the ability to learn quickly and explain its benefits in ways that matter to customers.
2. Enthusiasm for engaging with customers, taking ownership and helping build Xiaomi’s direct retail team in Germany.
3. The ability to listen, understand customer needs, explain technical and commercial information clearly, handle objections and confidently ask for the sale.
4. Personal accountability for sales conversion, with proactive follow-up, effective use of CRM and accurate, responsible handling of customer information.
5. Business-fluent German and a working command of English for communication with international teams.
6. A valid driving license (Class B).
7. Availability for location opening hours, including evenings and Saturdays, within a 40-hour working week. 
8. Career changers with relevant achievements and the ability and willingness to learn are explicitly welcome.

【Why join us】
1.Impact. Contribute to bringing Xiaomi's electric vehicles to Europe and shaping the customer experience for Xiaomi EV customers in Germany.
2.Innovation. Work with a driven team that takes ownership of preparing for a successful European market launch in 2027. Contribute ideas and turn them into practical improvements for customers.
3.Growth. Build your career as we grow from a launch preparation team into an established market operation. Expansion can open opportunities for broader responsibilities and progression, based on performance, readiness and business needs.

小米-7321926972887629932.title: Xiaomi EV - Lead/ Senior Exterior Designer（Automotive Design）
小米-7321926972887629932.description:
【Position Summary】
We are seeking a talented and visionary Lead Exterior Designer to join our Munich-based satellite design studio for a fast-growing Chinese EV company with strong roots in the tech industry.
You will play a leading role in developing bold, forward-thinking exterior designs for next-generation electric vehicles, blending advanced technology, brand character, and emotional appeal. Working in close collaboration with creative teams in Munich and headquarters in China, you will transform early concepts into production-ready designs that set new standards in mobility.

【Key Responsibilities】
1. Creative Leadership in Exterior Design
  - Lead exterior design projects from initial ideation through to production release.
  - Create compelling sketches, renderings, and 3D models to communicate design intent.
  - Work closely with clay and digital modeling teams to refine proportion, stance, surface quality, and details.
  - Ensure designs push innovation while meeting feasibility, aerodynamics, and safety requirements.

2. Cross-Functional Collaboration
  - Partner with engineering, aerodynamics, and manufacturing teams to resolve technical constraints without compromising design vision.
  - Align with CMF and UX teams to create cohesive brand expression across vehicle lines.
  - Maintain clear communication with the headquarters design and program management teams in China.

3. Trend & Technology Awareness
  - Monitor global design, lifestyle, and technology trends to inspire fresh ideas.
  - Incorporate EV-specific packaging opportunities into exterior design strategies.

4. Mentoring & Team Development
  - Support and guide junior exterior designers in their creative and professional growth.
  - Contribute to an open, collaborative studio culture that encourages innovation.
小米-7321926972887629932.requirements:
【Qualifications】
1. Essential:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Transportation Design or Industrial Design.
- Minimum 10 years’ professional experience in automotive exterior design (OEM or top-tier design consultancy).
- Strong portfolio demonstrating innovative exterior design concepts through to production.

小米-7426651396417011820.title: Xiaomi EV - Project Leader (Design Modelling)
小米-7426651396417011820.description:
【Role Overview】
As a Project Leader in Design Modeling, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering high-quality design models that translate creative visions into physical and digital representations. You will work closely with designers, engineers, and management to ensure the alignment of design intent with technical feasibility, overseeing projects from early concept through to production-ready models.

【Key Responsibilities】
       • Manage and coordinate the design modeling activities (both digital and physical).
       • Define design modeling goals, timelines, and resources in alignment with studio leadership.
       • Ensure seamless collaboration with suppliers.
       • Ensure seamless collaboration across design, engineering, and prototype workshops.
       • Oversee the creation of digital surface models (Class A / CAS) and physical clay or milling models.
       • Ensure models accurately capture and communicate the design intent.
       • Provide feedback and direction to modelers to refine aesthetics, proportions, and surfacing.
       • Process & Quality Management
       • Drive design reviews with senior management, presenting models at key milestones.
       • Implement best practices in digital modeling and physical build processes.
       • Ensures quality standards, accuracy, and feasibility of models are met within project deadlines.
       • Team & Stakeholder Communication
       • Act as the main contact between design leadership, modelers, and engineering teams.
       • Facilitate workshops and review sessions with cross-functional teams.
       • Provide mentorship, guidance, and performance feedback to modeling team members.
小米-7426651396417011820.requirements:
【Qualifications & Skills】
       • Degree in Transportation Design, Industrial Design, Engineering, or related field.
       • Proven experience (10+ years) in automotive design modeling, with leadership or coordination responsibilities.
       • Strong expertise in digital modeling tools (e.g., Alias, ICEM Surf, Blender, VRED, Catia) and/or physical clay modeling processes.
       • Excellent understanding of automotive design development, from concept to production.
       • Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
       • Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining design quality.
       • Fluency in English required and German language

【Location】
Munich, Germany – onsite presence required, with occasional travel to partner studios or engineering facilities.

【Why Join】
       • Work in one of Europe’s leading automotive design hubs.
       • Collaborate with world-class designers and modelers shaping future mobility.
       • Contribute to innovative, forward-looking vehicle design projects.

*Note: Please attach your CV in English.

小米-7470779933154623597.title: e2e预研实习生
小米-7470779933154623597.description: 1.探索多模态大模型、自监督预训练、世界模型等前沿技术，并应用于自动驾驶场景。
小米-7470779933154623597.requirements:
岗位职责：
探索多模态大模型、自监督预训练、世界模型等前沿技术，并应用于自动驾驶场景。
研究方向：
候选人需了解并熟悉以下至少一个方向：
视觉预训练（Visual Pretraining）：研究自监督学习、知识蒸馏、大规模数据预训练在视觉任务中的应用，熟悉相关工作如DINOv2等。
多模态学习（VLM/VLA）
Vision-Language-Model（VLM）：研究视觉语言大模型，熟悉相关工作如 VARGPT、VPiT、Ross 等。
Vision-Language-Action（VLA）：研究视觉语言动作大模型并探索在自动驾驶场景应用，熟悉相关工作如 EMMA等。
世界模型（World Model）
研究基于自监督学习与强化学习结合的端到端世界模型，应用于自动驾驶场景的状态建模、状态转移预测与规划决策。
熟悉相关工作，如 Dreamer 系列、Genie2、Doe-1、JEPA、Cosmos 等。
技术能力要求：
熟悉自监督和生成模型，了解大规模预训练，有经验者优先。
熟练掌握 PyTorch，具备模型开发与优化能力，能够提升训练效率。

小米-7669735413704263962.title: 业务培训经理
小米-7669735413704263962.description:
1.培训项目全流程运营
深度参与公司各类培训项目的策划与筹备，从需求调研出发，与业务部门紧密沟通，精准把握组织及员工的培训需求，协同制定贴合实际、切实可行的培训计划，包括确定培训主题、目标、内容框架及预期效果等。
负责培训项目的具体执行，涵盖培训场地协调、培训资料准备、培训讲师对接与管理等工作，确保培训项目按时、高质量交付。在培训实施过程中，密切关注现场情况，及时处理各类突发问题，保障培训顺利进行。
对培训项目进行全面总结与复盘，收集学员及业务部门反馈，运用数据分析等手段评估培训效果，形成详细的项目总结报告，为后续培训项目的优化提供有力依据。。
2.培训运营数据分析与报告
搭建培训运营数据指标体系，收集、整理培训相关数据，包括培训参与率、满意度、考试成绩、培训前后绩效变化等，运用数据分析工具进行深入分析，挖掘数据背后的问题与趋势。
定期生成培训运营数据分析报告，以直观、清晰的图表和文字形式呈现数据结果，为管理层决策提供数据支持，同时为培训项目的优化改进提供方向指引。
根据数据分析结果，提出针对性的培训运营优化建议，并跟进落实情况，持续提升培训运营效率与效果。
3.培训活动组织与推广
策划并组织各类培训相关活动，如培训启动会、结业典礼、学习分享会等，营造积极的学习氛围，提升员工参与培训的积极性与主动性。
运用多种渠道对培训项目及活动进行宣传推广，包括制作宣传海报、撰写推广文案、利用公司内部平台发布信息等，提高培训项目的知晓度与吸引力，确保培训资源得到充分利用。
小米-7669735413704263962.requirements:

2.具有 2 - 5 年培训运营相关工作经验，熟悉企业培训体系与流程，有快消、互联网等行业工作经验者优先。做过新零售业务岗位者优先。
3.熟练掌握数据分析工具，如 Excel（熟练运用数据透视表、函数公式等进行数据处理与分析）、SPSS 等，能够从数据中提取有价值的信息，并为决策提供支持。
4.具备良好的文案撰写与设计能力，能够制作吸引人的培训宣传资料及培训课件。
5.熟悉在线学习平台的运营与管理，了解平台功能架构及常见问题处理方法。
6.能讲课、能课程开发、能做培训项目运营与设计。
7.能够适应一定的及时落地及出差安排。

小米-7669735991439165734.title: 业务培训经理
小米-7669735991439165734.description:
1.培训战略规划与引领
紧密结合公司战略目标、业务发展需求以及行业人才发展趋势，牵头制定公司层面的培训战略规划与年度培训计划，明确培训工作的方向与重点，为组织能力提升提供有力支撑。
深度参与公司人才发展体系的构建与完善，从培训视角为人才选拔、培养、发展与保留等环节提供专业建议，确保培训工作与人才战略协同一致，助力公司打造高素质人才队伍。
2.培训项目设计与实施
针对公司关键人才群体（如企业关键业绩产出者等）及关键业务领域，独立设计并开发定制化的培训项目，运用前沿的培训理念与方法，确保培训内容的深度、广度与实用性。
全程主导培训项目的实施，亲自担任核心课程讲师或协调内外部顶级讲师资源，严格把控培训质量与效果。在项目执行过程中，密切关注学员反馈，及时调整优化培训方案，保障培训项目达到预期目标。
3.培训体系建设与优化
负责公司整体培训体系的建设与完善，包括培训课程体系、培训师资体系、培训评估体系等，建立健全培训管理制度与流程，推动培训工作的标准化、规范化与专业化发展。
定期对公司培训体系进行全面评估与诊断，运用数据分析、行业对标等手段，精准识别体系存在的问题与不足，提出针对性的优化改进方案，并组织实施，持续提升培训体系的效能与竞争力。
4.知识管理与经验沉淀
推动公司内部知识管理体系的建设与完善，组织收集、整理、提炼公司优秀实践经验、业务案例等知识资产，将其转化为培训课程与学习资料，促进知识共享与传承。
搭建学习交流平台，鼓励员工分享工作经验与心得体会，营造良好的学习氛围，推动公司学习型组织建设。
小米-7669735991439165734.requirements:
1.本科及以上学历，有业务经验者优先。
2.具有 5-8 年以上培训相关工作经验，其中至少 3年在大型企业从事培训管理或培训专家工作经验，有互联网、科技行业背景者优先。
3.具备丰富的高端培训项目设计与实施经验，成功主导过多个大型企业的领导力培训、人才发展项目，在培训体系建设与优化方面有显著成果。
4.精通培训需求分析、课程设计与开发、培训教学方法、培训评估等专业知识与技能，能够熟练运用 ADDIE 等培训设计模型开展工作。
5.熟练掌握数据分析工具，如 Excel、SPSS 等，能够运用数据驱动培训决策，评估培训效果。
6.具备优秀的课程开发与授课能力，能够独立开发高质量培训课程，并以生动、富有感染力的方式进行授课，获得学员高度认可。
7.能够适应一定频率的出差，满足跨地区培训工作需求。

小米-7616938266046204166.title: 业务资金管理实习生
小米-7616938266046204166.description:
1.     负责小米集团全部业务线的资金管理，主导资金部的业财融合；
2.     应对业务经营中遇到的各类资金需求，提供高效、可行的解决方案，并且具备较高的归纳、沉淀视屏，构建业务资金方案体系；
3.     与资金部总部COE深度配合，负责将总部制定的资金管理政策、流程宣贯、落地到国际部当地，提升资金管理能力，控制资金风险；
4.     与各业务线财经团队保持顺畅沟通，高效协作的工作机制。获取业务需求（计划、采购、供应、销售等）及前端业务信息到总部，协调总部资源积极支持业务发展；
5.     通过国际部当地资金人员清晰掌握当地营运资金周转、资金预算、现金流计划、外汇敞口等情况，解决业务诉求，发现风险点，提升资金效率；
6.     向管理层及时汇报资金风险及可优化提升方向。

小米-7677560509239036166.description:

聚焦职责：

2、深度挖掘用户消费痛点、运营业务需求，结合行业趋势与平台定位，输出产品方案、原型设计、PRD文档，推动产品落地；

5、深入业务场景，寻找业务痛点与AI的结合点，设计可落地的AI解决方案并推动上线。

小米-7677560924911438099.title: 中国区-供应链管培生
小米-7677560924911438099.description:
一款产品从上市前的备货，到上市后的爆发，再到生命周期末期的库存收尾，背后都需要有人不断判断：市场到底需要多少货？什么时候生产？货应该放在哪里？哪里可能缺货？哪里有可能积压？
    你需要把销售端看到的市场机会，转化成供应端真正能够执行的计划；也需要在销量变化、产能波动、渠道库存之间不断做判断和取舍。
    所以这不是一个单纯“跟计划、管库存”的岗位，而是一个站在产品、销售和供应链中间，对一款产品的供需平衡负责的岗位。
    职责包括：
    需求预测与产销协同：结合销售目标与市场需求，制定滚动预测、PSI及供应计划，推动产销协同；
    供应及生产计划：负责生产、备货及补货计划，协调供应商及代工厂，保障产品及时交付；
    库存与货量管理：负责进销存、分仓及货量分配管理，平衡现货率、库存水位与周转效率；
    渠道供应链管理：对接渠道（京东、天猫仓体系），后端链接销运供应链；
    数据分析与风险预警：跟踪销售、供应、库存及交付数据，识别缺货、产能及库存风险并及时预警；
    跨部门协同与持续优化：协同产品、销售、渠道、生产及物流等团队，解决供应链问题并持续优化运营效率。
小米-7677560924911438099.requirements:
本科及以上学历，供应链管理、物流管理、工商管理等相关专业优先；
    对供应链管理、库存计划工作有兴趣；
    思维缜密，对数据敏感，有较好的逻辑推理能力；
    善于沟通，具备敏锐的问题分析和解决能力。

小米-7675291324489173254.title: 中国区-创意视觉设计师
小米-7675291324489173254.description:
一款新品发布、一场重要活动、一次品牌态度的表达，每一张海报、每一场活动、每一次发布，背后都可能有你的创意。
你会从一个想法开始，去思考这张海报、这条片子到底要表达什么、怎么表达、才能最完美展现小米的产品，然后一路参与到制作和最终交付，把脑海里的创意真正变成屏幕上的作品。
最有成就感的地方，是有一天你刷到一条很多人在转发、讨论的海报或视频，会知道——这段被很多人看见的品牌表达，是你参与创造出来的。
所以我们希望找到的，是一个对设计有感觉、对创意有热爱，也愿意把一个好想法真正做到极致的人。

小米-7671129798714460470.description:

小米-7675292531886983475.title: 中国区-汽车培训师
小米-7675292531886983475.description:
1. 培训内容共创：协助团队完成新车上市培训素材的整理与迭代，参与将技术参数转化为一线销售易懂的销售话术和案例库。
2. 课程开发支持：在导师指导下，参与产品课程、竞品对比手册、实战演练脚本的开发，协助输出标准化的培训工具包。
3. 实战培训落地：参与动态试驾培训项目的组织与执行，协助模拟销售场景的搭建，确保培训内容贴合一线销售的真实作战需求。
4. 业务诊断助理：通过数据分析、一线走访或问卷调研，协助识别销售团队在产品知识和转化环节的薄弱点，为培训项目提供优化依据。
5. 培训效果追踪：负责培训后测数据、学员反馈的收集与复盘，协助撰写项目复盘报告，推动培训内容和形式的持续迭代。
小米-7675292531886983475.requirements:
1. 车辆工程、市场营销、教育学、心理学等相关专业优先。对汽车有浓厚兴趣，是身边同学公认的“懂车达人”。
2. 学习转化力：能快速理解复杂的产品技术（如三电系统、智能驾驶），并用通俗、有吸引力的语言向非专业人士讲清楚。有辩论赛、演讲、授课或内容创作经验者加分。
3. 沟通与推动力：具备良好的跨部门沟通意识，能与产品、销售、市场团队顺畅协作。有学生干部、项目组长或大型活动组织经验者优先。
4. 逻辑与洞察：善于从零散信息中提炼结构，具备基本的数据分析思维，能用事实和反馈指导工作改进。
5. 持有C1及以上驾照，驾驶技术熟练，对驾驶体验（加速、转向、底盘反馈）有自己的感知和见解（有赛道/场地驾驶体验者更佳）。

小米-7675291789649578266.title: 中国区-汽车线上技术专员
小米-7675291789649578266.description:
1、通过语音外呼/IM软件解决多方的线上技术服务需求，包括但不仅限于线上服务团队和服务中心的技术案件；
2、利用车辆的智能属性，通过远程的方式解决客户问题，减少不必要的进场，同时节省客户时间；

4、及时反馈诊断进展和结果，为线上服务、车间现场维修提供方向和方案指引，优化服务效率；
5、定期总结分析技术常见问题类型、占比及解决方案，协助统一操作标准，定期参与培训和分享；
6、紧密对接技术和远程诊断专家团队，掌握最新的产品信息、维修方案，尤其是软件系统的升级。
小米-7675291789649578266.requirements:

小米-7675292173633341723.description:
1. 产品讲解，⽤最热情的⽅式接待所有进店⽤户，提供专 业的产品讲解，结合⽤户情况与使⽤场景，使⽤户理解产 品的核⼼价值，激发⽤户对于品牌与产品的热情；  
2. 试乘试驾：为顾客提供专业的试乘试驾服务，通过在实 际驾乘体验过程中回答关于⻋辆使⽤的相关问题，解除顾 客⽤⻋顾虑；  
3. ⽤户体验：通过专业的咨询与服务，不断提升零售中⼼ ⽤户服务满意度，持续创造品牌与产品的推介者，同时与 交付、售后伙伴⾼效合作，解决⽤户购⻋及⽤⻋问题，提 供改进⼯作的建议和反馈；  
4. 团队合作：在达成个⼈关键业务指标的基础上，助⼒达 成团队销售⽬标，并不断提升业绩达成能⼒；  
5. 活动执⾏：⽀持各类型市场活动，持续吸引与挖掘潜在 ⽤户；  
6. ⻔店维护：配合零售店长和零售主管维持零售中⼼视觉陈列 标准和后区标准，维护展⻋、展具和零售店整体环境。
小米-7675292173633341723.requirements:
1. 对汽车产品和行业具备浓厚的兴趣与热情；具备日常浏览和关注汽车产品和行业相关内容的习惯；能够清晰表述自己对具体汽车品牌或产品的见解，且能够表述论点依据和逻辑；能够针对使用过的车辆表述基本乘用体验反馈比如优缺点分析；
2. 具备有效沟通能力；可以清晰、准确且有逻辑地传递关键信息；可以通过双向沟通高效地表达自己的主要观点及需求并获取对方的主要观点与需求；
3. 具备真诚、热爱、正直、拼搏的价值观，认同小米的愿景与文化价值观；
4. 认可认同销售工作，具备复杂情况下的应变能力和稳定的情绪控制；
5. 持有驾驶执照C本一年及以上，且能够独立地在公共道路进行安全和熟练的车辆驾驶。

小米-7257043697035772012.title: 中央空调售前技术支持
小米-7257043697035772012.description:
职位概述：多联机家用中央空调产品线的用户咨询与解决方案专家，负责为潜在用户提供专业的咨询服务，解答产品相关问题，并根据用户需求提供定制化的解决方案。通过高效的沟通和专业的知识，助力用户做出明智的购买决策。
职责：
用户咨询：接听用户咨询电话及在线咨询，及时解答用户对产品及服务的疑问，提供专业指导。
需求分析：与用户沟通，深入了解其需求，评估并提出合适的产品解决方案。
产品讲解：根据用户需求，进行产品讲解，展示产品特点与优势，为用户种草。
方案制定：深入挖掘用户需求并制定符合的产品解决方案。
市场反馈：收集用户反馈和市场需求，向产品团队提供建议，促进产品改进。
销售支持：配合销售团队，协助制定用户报价及合同条款，提供售前支持。
培训与知识分享：定期参与培训，更新产品知识，提升服务质量，并分享经验与技巧。

任职要求：
本科及以上学历，市场营销、管理或相关专业优先。
具有5年以上多联机、中央空调产品线售前支持、方案设计相关工作经验。
优秀的沟通能力和人际交往能力，能够与不同层级的用户建立良好关系。
强烈的服务意识与团队合作精神，具备解决问题的能力。
具备基本的市场分析能力，能够理解用户需求并转化为商业机会。
熟练使用办公软件及CRM系统，有能力快速掌握新工具。

小米-7659317049558812934.title: 云算力采购
小米-7659317049558812934.description:
1. 算力设备采购全链路管理
- 负责 AI 服务器 / 通用算力服务器整机及核心部件的Source-to-Pay 全流程闭环管理，覆盖需求对齐、寻源策略、询比价与商务谈判、合同签订、订单执行、交付跟进、验收结算全生命周期；
- 保障算力设备按期、保质、合规交付，支撑公司大模型 / AI 业务算力资源稳定供给。
2. 市场洞察与成本优化
- 持续跟踪 AI 服务器核心物料（GPU、CPU、HBM/DDR5 内存、企业级存储、高速网卡等）的市场动态、价格趋势、产能变化及行业政策，定期输出算力供应链行业分析报告；
- 具备逆向 BOM 级成本拆解能力，基于业务体量与市场行情进行成本合理性分析，识别价格异常并提供议价依据；
- 通过战略寻源、多供应商竞争、框架协议谈判等方式，实现采购成本最优。
3. 供应商生态建设与风险管控
- 负责算力设备供应商的开发、准入评估、绩效考核及全生命周期管理，搭建稳定高效的供应商资源池；
- 优化供应结构，提升关键物料（高端 GPU、HBM 内存等）的供应保障能力与风险应对能力；
- 维护与核心供应商的战略合作关系，推动长期供货协议落地，应对供应链波动风险。
4. 采购体系与合规内控建设
- 参与算力采购管理制度、业务流程及合规体系建设与优化，确保采购活动全流程可追溯；
- 推动采购数据沉淀与分析，搭建算力采购成本数据库，为采购策略制定提供数据支撑。
5. 业务协同与跨部门协作
- 深入理解公司 AI / 大模型业务战略，贴近业务一线，探知算力需求痛点；
- 协同业务、运维、财务、法务等部门，制定适配业务发展的采购解决方案。

1. 学历背景：本科及以上学历，计算机、通信、电子工程等工科相关专业优先；

-熟悉 AI 服务器整机及核心部件的技术参数、市场行情与供应渠道；具备部件级成本分析与逆向 BOM 拆解能力
-独立承接过大型算力采购项目，熟悉从整机到芯片级的采购全流程；掌握商务谈判、供应商管理、成本控制、合约管理等核心能力
-具备市场洞察与行业分析能力，能基于市场变化制定采购策略；逻辑清晰，善于用数据发现并解决复杂问题
-有采购流程标准化、成本数据库搭建或采购数字化转型经验者优先

- 良好的沟通协调能力与跨部门协作能力，能高效推进复杂项目落地；
- 诚信正直，责任心强，具备较强的合规意识与风险管控意识；
- 积极主动，贴近业务，具备较强的业务理解能力与需求转化能力；

小米-7695681188183378186.title: 交付履约采购助理
小米-7695681188183378186.description:
1.账物流：负责定标项目从合同签订、订单下发、发票校验到付款申请的全流程跟进，确保合同执行与账务处理及时、准确、合规，处理合同履约过程中的变更与异常。
2.实物流：负责定标项目的交付计划制定与跟踪，协同供应商排产、发货与到货安排，组织交付验收，确保物料按期、按质交付，及时协调处理交付过程中的延误与质量问题。
3.绩效流：负责中国区采购供应商的日常绩效数据收集与考核评价，协同处理供应商异常事项，跟踪整改落实情况，推动供应商持续改进。
4.履约数据管理：维护采购履约相关台账与系统数据，定期输出交付履约分析报表，为采购决策提供数据支持。
5.跨部门协同：对接需求部门、财务、仓储及供应商，保障采购交付履约全流程顺畅运转，提升整体交付效率与协作体验。
小米-7695681188183378186.requirements:
1.2027届本科及以上应届毕业生，供应链管理、物流管理、工商管理、国际贸易、机械/电子类相关专业优先；
2.具备良好的沟通协调能力与跨部门协作意识，工作细致、责任心强，能高效推进多任务处理；
3.具备一定的数据分析能力，熟练使用 Office 办公软件（Excel、PPT 等），有财务/合同/供应链相关实习经历者优先；
4.具备问题分析与解决能力，能主动发现并推动解决履约过程中的异常事项；
5.认可采购与供应链管理方向，有长期深耕交付履约领域的意愿。
